title: Certain emails cause pop download to fail.
creator: Bob_92604
content: Certain emails are causing POP download to not complete. The messages that successfully download are left on the server and if POP download is rerun they are duplicated but newer email are still not downloaded. If the problem message is moved out of the way, POP download completes. The problem has only occurred with emails that have embedded reply and forward buttons at the end of the message. This has happened with messages from three sources. An image of one of these emails is included with this report. I do not recall receiving any other messages with these embedded reply and forward buttons. Thank you for your help.

title: I don't want a reading pane.
creator: kebowles
content: There is a reading pane to the right of the message list. This to my way of thinking (IMO) violates privacy and security. Everything is exposed and if a person hacks into my computer, he has all sorts of information from the reading pane. I want to remove the reading pane the way I did in Outlook. Ken

title: Cannot switch from POP to IMAP account
creator: mlmagee
content: I am following the instructions in the 8/10/25 Thunderbird support document "Switch from POP to IMAP account." After getting to "Create the IMAP account," it says to open "File > New > Existing" to enter the changes. I do not see "Existing" as a menu option. The closest menu option is "File > New > Email account." The dialog box that opens looks completely different from that shown in Step 3 of the instructions. So far I have been unsuccessful using that dialog box, as it does not recognize my host name.
